description: Funding arbitrage scanner across 8 exchanges (Bybit, Hyperliquid, dYdX, Gate, Kraken, Bitfinex, Deribit, OKX): for every coin the widest cross-venue perp funding spread, the long and short venue, both funding rates, gross and fee-adjusted net APR and breakeven days, with a 24h volume liquidity filter. Funding rate arbitrage, basis trade and carry screening of perpetual swaps. Data only, no advice. Bad input is free; under 3 venues not charged. Price: $0.005 per successful call, paid over x402 (USDC on Base); pass the payment in _meta["x402/payment"].

fee_pct.description: Taker fee per fill, percent of notional (4 fills). Default 0.05.

holding_days.description: Holding period used to amortise fees in net_apr_pct. Default 30.

min_apr.description: Minimum gross spread in APR percent. Default 10.

min_volume_usd.description: Both legs need at least this 24 h volume (USD). Default 0.

name: funding_arbitrage_scan
title: Funding arbitrage scanner (all coins)
